answer: Weight each agent not by its peak stake but by the low-water mark of collateral it has kept continuously locked in channels with distinct counterparties across many settlement tides. Like counting the heartwood rings in timber, only sustained depth earns voice; a sybil flash-funds clones that drain back to near zero between tides and score nothing, while any synchronized zephyr of simultaneous top-ups across linked accounts is flagged and discounted. Flooding thus demands real capital held down for the long haul, per head.
